command_line:
set -eu
cat > job.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
d <- read.csv(args[1], stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
required <- c("DishNumber","StrainNumber","Ratio","Replicate","Area","Circularity","Round")
if (!all(required %in% names(d))) stop("Missing required columns")
if (anyNA(d[c("StrainNumber","Ratio","Area")])) stop("Missing model fields")
out <- aggregate(list(n=rep(1L,nrow(d))), by=d[c("StrainNumber","Ratio")], FUN=sum)
out <- out[order(as.character(out[["StrainNumber"]]), out[["Ratio"]]),]
out[["area_min"]] <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(out)), function(i) min(d[["Area"]][as.character(d[["StrainNumber"]])==as.character(out[["StrainNumber"]][i]) & d[["Ratio"]]==out[["Ratio"]][i]]), numeric(1))
out[["area_max"]] <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(out)), function(i) max(d[["Area"]][as.character(d[["StrainNumber"]])==as.character(out[["StrainNumber"]][i]) & d[["Ratio"]]==out[["Ratio"]][i]]), numeric(1))
write.table(out, file="combination_audit.tsv", sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
RSCRIPT
